label: plan06
title: Hybrid Strength & Fat Loss Program (Machine Focused)

context.injuries: I am dealing with some lower back and upper back issue. So have to avoid back heavy excercises like Deadlifts and excercises that strain upper back muscles like overhead press.

plan.title: Hybrid Strength & Fat Loss Program (Machine Focused)

weeks.name: Upper Body Strength (Push Focus) & Metabolic Finisher

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Arm circles 20x, band pull-aparts 15x, shoulder CARs 5x each, cat-cow 10x, thoracic rotation 10x each, hip flexor stretch 30s each

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Start 30lb. Add 2.5-5lb when all sets completed with good form.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.notes: Start 100lb. Add 5-10lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on controlled movement and full range.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly Machine
exercises.notes: Start 50lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on a good stretch and squeeze.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Start 15lb. Add 2.5lb when all sets completed with good form.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (Rope Attachment)
exercises.notes: Start 40lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with good form. Maintain elbows tucked and focus on triceps contraction.

exercises.name: Metabolic Finisher: Treadmill HIIT
exercises.notes: Alternate between 1 minute high-intensity sprint/jog and 1 minute brisk walk for 10-15 minutes. Adjust speed/incline as needed.

weeks.name: Lower Body Strength (Quad/Glute Focus) & Metabolic Finisher

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Leg swings 10x each, hip circles 10x each, bodyweight squats 10x, ankle rolls 30s each, cat-cow 10x, child's pose 30s, hip flexor stretch 30s each

exercises.name: Front Barbell Squats
exercises.notes: Start 95lb. Add 5-10lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on keeping an upright torso, elbows high, and core braced to protect your back. Prioritize form over weight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Start 20lb dumbbells. Add 2.5-5lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on balance and depth.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Start 70lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with good form.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Curl
exercises.notes: Start 60lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with good form.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Start 90lb. Add 5-10lb when all sets completed with good form.

exercises.name: Metabolic Finisher: Farmer's Carry
exercises.notes: Hold heavy dumbbells or kettlebells in each hand, walk for distance/time. Maintain upright posture, braced core. Work for 10-15 minutes, taking short breaks as needed.

weeks.name: Upper Body Strength (Pull Focus) & Metabolic Finisher

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Arm circles 20x, band pull-aparts 15x, shoulder CARs 5x each, cat-cow 10x, thoracic rotation 10x each, hip flexor stretch 30s each

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
exercises.notes: Start 100lb. Add 5-10lb when all sets completed with good form. Avoid excessive leaning or arching to protect the lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Neutral Grip)
exercises.notes: Start 90lb. Add 5-10lb when all sets completed with good form. Maintain neutral spine to protect lower back.

exercises.name: Machine Reverse Fly
exercises.notes: Start 30lb. Add 2.5-5lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on scapular retraction to target rear delts and upper back.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pulls
exercises.notes: Start 25lb. Add 2.5-5lb when all sets completed with good form. Pull towards face, focusing on external rotation and rear delt contraction.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curls (Straight Bar/EZ Bar Attachment)
exercises.notes: Start 40lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on controlled eccentric and peak contraction.

exercises.name: Metabolic Finisher: Burpees
exercises.notes: Perform burpees continuously for 10-15 minutes, taking short breaks as needed. Focus on controlled movement and avoid excessive lumbar extension.

weeks.name: Lower Body Strength (Hamstring/Glute Focus) & Metabolic Finisher

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Leg swings 10x each, hip circles 10x each, bodyweight squats 10x, ankle rolls 30s each, cat-cow 10x, child's pose 30s, hip flexor stretch 30s each

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Start 135lb. Add 10-20lb when all sets completed with good form. Use a pad for comfort. Focus on glute squeeze at the top, maintaining a neutral spine and core brace to protect the lower back. Prioritize form over weight.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.notes: Start 50lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on glute contraction and hinge mechanics, avoiding lower back strain.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickbacks
exercises.notes: Start 20lb. Add 2.5-5lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on squeezing the glute at the top of the movement. Maintain a stable core and avoid arching your back.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Abduction
exercises.notes: Start 15lb. Add 2.5lb when all sets completed with good form. Focus on glute medius activation.

exercises.name: Cable Ab Crunches
exercises.notes: Start 50lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with good form. Control the movement, avoid jerking.

exercises.name: Metabolic Finisher: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.notes: Set treadmill to 10-15% incline at a brisk walking pace. Maintain consistent effort for 10-15 minutes.
